restart_rule: Future threads analysing alleged criminality from the 2011 Community events should begin from the canonical control, Declarations 012 and 013, and all three graph datasets, then re-check current repository/live-site deltas before drawing conclusions.
publication_boundaries: Gil's phrase estafa concursal is an attributed umbrella description and must be decomposed into actual Spanish offence elements.
Shadow/de facto administration is an attributed functional allegation unless legally established actor by actor.
Possible initial deception of the insolvency administrator and possible actual knowledge are alternative hypotheses until evidence resolves them.
Recklessness is an attributed characterization requiring duty, notice, access to information and failure-to-inquire analysis.
Possible deception of the court requires an exact representation or omission, actual receipt, material reliance and actor-specific state of mind.
Gil's word morphed is preserved as a metaphor for functional convergence; it is not a legal merger, personal identity or automatic transfer of knowledge, intent or liability.
Multiple direct bridges support a convergence investigation, but not every historic actor has a direct Acosta Matos bridge.
Campanario's pre-concurso Community/litigation role and prior insolvency practice are documented context; they do not prove a plan to cause LPB insolvency or a direct later Acosta Matos handover.
The López Noriega-to-Acosta Matos bridge remains indirect through Prieto unless a direct mandate, company or instruction is located.
Rodríguez-Batllori remains on a separate alleged enablement/adoption track and is not automatically classified as a private member of the Acosta Matos perimeter.
Campanario-Rodriguez-Batllori friendship/appointment coordination remains attributed/open unless independently corroborated.
Notice is not knowledge of falsity; knowledge opportunity is not intent; benefit is not concert.
Later CAM/Acosta Matos convergence must not be projected backwards as proof of a 2011 agreement.
Adverse and exculpatory evidence must travel with every criminal hypothesis.
